name: Insider deals

subjectOf.text: Public price discovery is a necessary condition for consumer choice: without public pricing, consumers cannot realistically select the service provider that offers the highest value, and the resulting opacity enables insider deals that let a group of firms dictate price.
subjectOf.abstract: Price discovery is a key public services function because, without public pricing, consumers cannot realistically select the service provider that provides the highest value to the job poster.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Code Review DAO (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4734750

subjectOf.text: Price discovery is a public service function because without public pricing consumers cannot realistically select the service provider offering the highest value, and the resulting lack of transparency enables insider deals to the detriment of clients forced into prices dictated by a group of firms.
subjectOf.abstract: without public pricing, consumers cannot realistically select the service provider that provides the highest value to the job poster. The lack of transparency enables insider deals to the detriment of the clients, who are forced into the price a group of firms dictates.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, AI Learning - Decentralized Governance to Optimize Human Output Datasets for AI Learning (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4755632
